slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-300 textDefault edit
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 ASCII or binary DXF source has a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE with one existing group-300 textDefault string. Its isolated transaction changes only textDefault to a printable-ASCII value; group-3 description is retained unchanged in the same source and output.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 300 as Default MText Contents
fieldEvidence.selectedTextDomain: Printable 7-bit ASCII; non-ASCII bytes and control characters are refused until a lossless code-page/Unicode profile is qualified
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role evidence plus authored ASCII-only adapter transaction; not MText parser/rendering, independent producer, Unicode/code-page or native consumer semantic qualification

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The MLEADERSTYLE must be root-reachable and match its captured raw body and immutable baseline. It must contain exactly one existing group-300 STRING matching typed textDefault. The replacement must contain only printable ASCII bytes, and textDefault must be the only changed typed payload field. The adjacent group-3 description, identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and remaining style payload must remain source-equal.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing group-300 string in a copy of the captured body. Preserve all ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 300, raw/typed conflict, simultaneous edits, non-ASCII/control text, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: The shared string-field regression separately exercises group 300 and group 3 with ASCII and binary sources, same-format and opposite-format output, exact unique emitted STRING fields, and fresh typed readback. The group-300 output is `edited-default-text`; the group-3 description remains source-equal.
contract.failureAndRetry: A raw group-300 mutation that conflicts with typed textDefault refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Non-ASCII and newline-containing typed values also refuse without replacing the sentinel. Restoring the raw baseline and requesting printable ASCII permits same-adapter retry and exact readback.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records retain raw replay. The transaction is AC1027-only and one field per record. It does not establish MText formatting or rendered appearance. Group-3 has its own bounded receipt; other strings, non-ASCII/code-page profiles, DWG-origin writing and complete document closure remain unqualified.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 300 `source-default-text` and group 3 `source-style-description`; each field is edited independently from runtime-generated sources in temporary storage.

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. For both group 300 and group 3, generated ASCII/binary tests cover raw/source agreement, conflict rollback, non-ASCII/control-text refusal, same-adapter retry, exact output group, typed readback and cross-format conversion.

limitations: Evidence qualifies only printable-ASCII group-300 textDefault edits on authored AC1027 sources. It does not prove MText syntax/rendering, Unicode/code-page handling, independent producer variation, native acceptance, other versions, DWG editing or complete document closure.
The support ledger remains closed; no format support claim is promoted.
